sources.citation: Douglas B. West, Introduction to Graph Theory, 2nd ed.; standard independent-set/independence-number definitions.
Romeo Rizzi, “A short proof of König's matching theorem,” Journal of Graph Theory 33 (2000), 138–139.
Willem H. Haemers, “Hoffman's ratio bound,” Linear Algebra and its Applications 617 (2021), 215–219.
Aimee S. A. Johnson and David M. McClendon, “Finite odometer factors of rank one Z^d-actions,” arXiv:2306.09477; Lemma 2.7 equidistributes every finite-index coset along every Følner sequence in Z^d.
Sabidussi's classical Cartesian-product bipartiteness theorem, quoted as Lemma 1 in Kurauskas et al., Journal of Combinatorial Optimization 49 (2025), Article 31.
Classical character diagonalization of finite abelian Cayley graphs; a modern statement appears as Lemma 2.5 in “Intersective sets over abelian groups,” Designs, Codes and Cryptography (2025/2026).
I. van Heuven van Staereling, B. de Keijzer, G. Schäfer, “The Ground-Set-Cost Budgeted Maximum Coverage Problem,” MFCS 2016; incidence graph a forest is identified with Berge-acyclicity.
Standard cycle-rank identity ν(G)=|E|-|V|+c(G), explicitly stated for finite graphs in Si Kaddour–Tahhan Bittar, Contributions to Discrete Mathematics 5(1) (2010).
Encyclopedia of Mathematics, “Matroid”: vector configurations give matroids; minimal dependent sets are circuits; graph forests/circuits give the graphic matroid.
Zeev Dvir, “On the size of Kakeya sets in finite fields,” JAMS 22 (2009), arXiv:0803.2336.
Simeon Ball, Aart Blokhuis, Diego Domenzain, “A finite version of the Kakeya problem,” arXiv:1503.06639.
Accepted Gen2 Packing Result RR-71FABB059247512DF390 and Driver review.
Accepted Gen2 Kakeya Result RR-9D6C3A7E42B1F805C264 and Driver review.

claims.accepted_claim: Once a finite Cell conflict relation C is declared, admissible packings are exactly independent sets and the optimum occupancy is alpha(G)/|V|.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: Hypotheses coincide after the Cell states are made graph vertices and the declared symmetric irreflexive conflict relation is made the edge set. No P000-specific mathematics remains in the optimization statement.
claims.residue: Choosing/deriving C natively is not supplied by graph theory; route that only to NONOVERLAP_SELECTOR.

claims.accepted_claim: Finite packing optimum and occupancy are invariant under every declared Cell bijection preserving the conflict relation.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: This is the specialization of the general fact that graph isomorphisms preserve independent sets and alpha(G). The external statement applies to arbitrary graphs, not just Cell models.
claims.residue: Only the question whether a carrier/P000 transformation is genuinely a native conflict-graph automorphism survives.

claims.accepted_claim: For a periodic lift from a finite quotient of Z^6, every Følner sequence yields density equal to the occupied quotient fraction.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: Johnson–McClendon Lemma 2.7 already states the stronger coset-level fact: every Følner sequence in Z^d asymptotically puts 1/[Z^d:H] mass in every coset of every finite-index subgroup H. Summing the occupied cosets gives the accepted theorem verbatim.
claims.residue: Bare P000 does not currently supply the translation action, finite-index period subgroup, or Følner notion; route only to TRANSLATION_FOLNER_SELECTOR.

claims.accepted_claim: For a fixed periodic fundamental-domain tiling, finite-window density error is confined to incomplete boundary tiles.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: The exact inequality is elementary periodic counting, and the vanishing boundary/volume principle is the defining mechanism behind Følner sequences. The accepted result is a finite specialized estimate, not a new density principle.
claims.residue: Native meaning of admissible windows still depends on a declared translation/periodic structure.

claims.accepted_claim: The declared torus conflict graph T_n on (Z/nZ)^6 with neighbors differing by ±e_i is the sixfold Cartesian product of C_n and a finite abelian Cayley graph; for even n it is bipartite by parity.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: This is exactly standard graph-product/Cayley structure. Even C_n is bipartite and repeated Cartesian products preserve bipartiteness; the parity map is the explicit two-coloring.
claims.residue: The graph remains a declared pressure-test model; no classical source identifies it canonically with bare P000.

claims.accepted_claim: For even n, alpha(T_n)=n^6/2, witnessed by one parity class and certified above by the E1 perfect matching.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: The lower set is one side of the standard bipartition. The explicit E1 pairing is a perfect matching, so an independent set contains at most one endpoint of each matched edge. More generally König's theorem places matching/vertex-cover duality in standard bipartite matching theory.
claims.residue: No numerical Packing novelty remains under the declared torus hypotheses.

claims.accepted_claim: The spectral upper certificate alpha(T_n)/n^6<=1/2 follows from degree 12, least eigenvalue -12, and Hoffman's ratio bound.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: Hoffman's ratio bound is exactly alpha<=N(-tau)/(d-tau) for a d-regular graph. Character diagonalization of the abelian Cayley graph gives lambda(k)=2 sum_j cos(2pi k_j/n), so tau=-12 for even n; substitution gives 1/2 exactly.
claims.residue: This is a reusable certificate only after a native conflict graph/translation quotient has been declared.

claims.accepted_claim: Translations and the realized carrier-S4 coordinate permutations preserve the declared conflict relation and therefore preserve density.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: This is again ordinary graph-automorphism invariance. The only nonclassical content is the typing guard that carrier permutations must first be realized as native automorphisms.
claims.residue: Do not promote carrier S4 to the full native P000 rotation group.

claims.accepted_claim: For q:T_kn->T_n given by coordinate reduction mod n, the full inverse image of an independent set is independent and constant fiber size k^6 preserves occupancy exactly.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: This is the generic pullback fact for an edge-preserving map together with uniform-fiber counting. The accepted theorem specializes it to the declared torus quotient.
claims.residue: Whether q is a physical P000 scale refinement is not decided by the combinatorial cover.

claims.accepted_claim: The finite quotient/refinement law does not by itself make n->kn the physical P000 scale refinement.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: External graph-cover theory can analyze a declared refinement map but cannot choose which carrier quotient is the native physical scale map. This is a project semantic selector, not an external graph theorem.
claims.residue: PHYSICAL_REFINEMENT_SELECTOR survives. NO_MATERIAL_MATCH is not a novelty certificate.

claims.accepted_claim: Bare current P000 does not canonically provide the non-overlap/conflict relation or the translation/Følner structure required for a global packing density.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: Classical packing/graph/amenable-group theories start after an exclusion predicate and an ambient action/measure notion have been fixed. They do not derive those P000-specific semantics from the current Cell ontology.
claims.residue: NONOVERLAP_SELECTOR and TRANSLATION_FOLNER_SELECTOR survive. NO_MATERIAL_MATCH is not a novelty certificate.

claims.accepted_claim: For six affine Cell paths with linearly independent direction vectors, the bipartite incidence graph between paths and multiply-covered Cells is a forest.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: A cycle of alternating paths and shared Cells gives nonzero scalar increments along the participating direction vectors whose telescoping sum is zero, hence a vector dependence/circuit. Independent directions forbid this. In hypergraph language the resulting path hypergraph is Berge-acyclic exactly when its incidence graph is acyclic.
claims.residue: The statement is carrier/readout-relative; mixed/refining native direction families are not covered.

claims.accepted_claim: For six independent paths the overlap defect D=sum_x(m_x-1) is at most 5.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: Let s be the number of shared-Cell nodes and E=sum_x m_x the incidence-edge count. For a forest with c components, E=(6+s)-c, so D=E-s=6-c<=5. This is exactly the standard forest/cycle-rank identity specialized to six path nodes.
claims.residue: No new six-dimensional combinatorial inequality remains once forest incidence is granted.

claims.accepted_claim: For r>=2 in the declared sufficiently large finite window, the exact six-axis support optimum is K_6(r)=6r-5.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: The lower bound is the forest defect identity: |union_i L_i|=6r-D>=6r-5. Equality is realized whenever the six path nodes are connected by a tree of five singleton overlaps. Thus the number is a direct specialization of ordinary forest incidence counting, not a classical Kakeya breakthrough.
claims.residue: Only the native legality of direction families and refinement survives.

claims.accepted_claim: Equality K_6(r)=6r-5 requires connected overlap incidence; six-way concurrency is not required, and the nonconcurrent r=2 chain is a valid equality witness.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: Within a forest, D=6-c. Equality D=5 is equivalent to c=1 after all six path nodes participate, i.e. connected incidence. A tree may have arbitrary shape, so concurrency is not part of the equality condition.
claims.residue: Do not spend continuation budget classifying tree shapes under the same six independent directions.

claims.accepted_claim: Linear independence is essential: the dependent direction set {e1,e2,e1+e2} admits an overlap cycle and an r=2 support-3 countermodel, beating the independent-direction forest value 4.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: The three direction vectors contain the elementary vector-matroid circuit e1+e2-(e1+e2)=0. A circuit is precisely the standard minimal dependence that permits a closed incidence cycle; the support-3 realization is a small explicit specialization.
claims.residue: What remains is whether P000 natively admits such mixed/refining directions under its actual rotation/refinement semantics.

claims.accepted_claim: Classical finite/discrete Kakeya theory is relevant only as an adjacent comparison, not as the antecedent of K_6(r)=6r-5.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: Dvir's finite-field Kakeya set contains a line in every direction of F_q^n and is bounded at q^n scale; Ball–Blokhuis–Domenzain likewise study large direction grids. The accepted GEO6 theorem uses exactly six typed lattice directions, finite length-r Cell paths, and incidence-forest structure. Direction universe, ambient algebra, objective and asymptotic regime differ materially.
claims.residue: These papers block any broad 'new Kakeya theorem' language but do not resolve MIXED_DIRECTION_SELECTOR.

claims.accepted_claim: The full native P000 direction family beyond carrier S4, including mixed/refining direction circuits across refinement levels, remains unresolved.
claims.hypothesis_comparison: External matroid/Kakeya theory can analyze a supplied direction family but cannot decide which carrier combinations count as native P000 directions or how they transport across Cell refinement.
claims.residue: MIXED_DIRECTION_SELECTOR survives. NO_MATERIAL_MATCH is not a novelty certificate.

selector_map.what_external_math_does: Once C is declared, graph theory completely handles finite occupancy, automorphism invariance, matching and Hoffman certificates.
selector_map.missing_native_datum: A canonically selected/derived native Cell non-overlap or exclusion relation, with equivariance and compatibility with any refinement.
selector_map.current_evidence: Gen2 Packing explicitly freezes NO_CANONICAL_BARE_P000_NONOVERLAP_RELATION. First-wave CONTACT_SELECTOR is also still unresolved.
selector_map.driver_action: Highest leverage, but do not publish a successor until an accepted P000/Full-Cell contact/exclusion datum is named.

selector_map.what_external_math_does: For a declared Z^6/amenable translation action and finite period quotient, periodic density along every Følner sequence is classical.
selector_map.missing_native_datum: A native translation action (or substitute amenable action/invariant-mean structure), plus admissible finite periods/windows.
selector_map.driver_action: Do not reprove density limits; first obtain a native action datum.

selector_map.what_external_math_does: Constant-fiber graph-cover pullback preserves the declared density exactly.
selector_map.missing_native_datum: A theorem identifying the combinatorial q_{kn,n} (or another cover) with the physical P000 scale-refinement map.
selector_map.current_evidence: T5 precision-refinement machinery is reusable for finite covers, but the accepted Packing return explicitly denies that this alone supplies physical scale semantics.
selector_map.driver_action: Treat T5 as method reuse, not as the missing physical datum.

selector_map.what_external_math_does: Given direction vectors, matroid circuit/forest theory predicts exactly when overlap cycles may occur; finite Kakeya literature supplies adjacent global-direction techniques.
selector_map.missing_native_datum: A native-legal mixed/refining direction family/orbit under the actually granted P000/Full-Cell action, including transport across refinement.
selector_map.current_evidence: Gen2 Kakeya freezes CARRIER_S4 != FULL_NATIVE_P000_ROTATION_GROUP and leaves the first native mixed/refining direction circuit unresolved.
selector_map.driver_action: Do not extend K_6 formula beyond six independent typed axes until such a direction datum is accepted.

driver_recommendation.why_highest_leverage: It is the common prerequisite for every native Packing optimization statement and couples directly to the still-unresolved first-wave CONTACT_SELECTOR. Classical graph/matching/spectral theory becomes available immediately once a canonical Cell exclusion relation is accepted.
driver_recommendation.authorization_guard: Do not publish a successor task merely from this audit. A successor must first name an already accepted P000/Full-Cell datum capable of resolving at least one surviving selector; none is identified in the currently accepted inputs.

tool_reuse.reused_method: GEO6 first-wave claim/source classification matrix and task-local exact regression pattern; ordinary graph/matroid/Følner antecedents are cited rather than rebuilt as a new global toolbox.

novelty_guard: NO_MATERIAL_MATCH is not a novelty certificate. It means only that the searched external theories do not decide the P000-specific semantic selector under equivalent hypotheses.
